claims.text: Runbook v2: first verify that the standby processing queue is ready, then perform failover according to the runbook.
PAY-101 tracks the payment-service incident. See the final postmortem and the current runbook.
Final root cause: retry configuration mismatched the timeout budget, causing a backlog of duplicate requests. Confirmed at 10:00 +08:00. Follow-ups: PAY-102 and PAY-103.

Payment-service incident thread: 09:00 cache invalidation was an early hypothesis. 09:15 the cache hypothesis was withdrawn. 10:00 the final postmortem confirmed retry configuration and timeout budget mismatch. CANARY_THREAD_4K2.

[SYNTHETIC]
Beginning 2026-11-01, service tokens expire after thirty minutes; before that date they expire after sixty minutes.
Payment-retry remains a controlled pilot. No GA date is confirmed; use the capability page and release approval.
Release decision: controlled pilot approved. General availability (GA) not approved. PAY-102 Done is not customer release approval.
Payment-retry is available only to the controlled pilot. General availability (GA) is not approved. No general release date is confirmed.
External partners can consult the shared payment-retry capability page for pilot limits. This collaboration channel contains partner onboarding guidance.
Describe payment-retry only within the approved pilot scope. Unconfirmed items: general availability date and expansion beyond pilot customers.
PAY-102 code fix: Done. Code completion does not approve general customer release.
PAY-103 protective measures: In Progress. Owner: Maya.
